# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Overview

Build a single-page e-commerce landing site for **Fresh Pantry**, a neighborhood grocery brand that celebrates unique, high-quality food products at great prices. The audience is health-conscious grocery shoppers who love discovering new finds — think the excitement of wandering a well-curated store aisle, translated to the web. The tone should feel **warm, playful, and modern** — approachable but polished, never corporate or sterile.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Think fresh greens, warm cream/off-white backgrounds, pops of sunny yellow or terracotta for accents. Avoid harsh neons or overly dark tones.
- **Typography:** A friendly rounded sans-serif for headings (something like Nunito or Poppins) paired with a clean body font. Keep it legible and inviting.
- **Imagery mood:** Bright, natural-light food photography vibes. Use placeholder images that suggest colorful produce, pantry staples, and cozy store interiors.
- **Layout:** Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows — the whole page should feel like a pleasant stroll through a sunlit market.

## Key Priorities

1. **The featured products carousel** is the centerpiece interaction — make sure the left/right navigation feels smooth and the product cards (with images, names, and prices) are visually appealing and easy to scan.
2. **The store locator** should feel functional and responsive: a zip code input with a search button that reveals mock store results. This drives the core business goal of in-store visits.
3. **Brand highlights stats** (500+ stores, 4,000+ products, etc.) should be presented as an eye-catching banner — use bold numbers with supporting labels to build credibility at a glance.
4. **Category hover effects** should feel delightful but not distracting — a gentle scale-up with an overlay is the target.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, all interaction specs, data display requirements, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Brand

Fresh Pantry is your neighborhood grocery store reimagined — a place where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise. We curate unique, hard-to-find food products alongside everyday essentials, all at prices that make you smile. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

Brand colors: #2D6A4F (primary forest green), #F4A261 (warm accent orange), #FEFAE0 (soft cream background)

## Hero Content

Title: "Discover Everyday Deliciousness"
Subtitle: "Unique flavors, quality ingredients, and unbeatable prices — all waiting for you at your neighborhood Fresh Pantry."
CTA: "Find a Store Near You" | "Explore This Week's Picks"

- Products
- Our Stores
- Recipes
- About Us

|---|---|---|

| Cauliflower Gnocchi | Light, pillowy gnocchi made with real cauliflower | $2.99 |
| Mandarin Orange Chicken | Crispy chicken bites in a sweet & tangy mandarin sauce | $4.99 |
| Unexpected Cheddar Cheese | Aged cheddar with crystalline crunch and complex flavor | $3.99 |
| Spicy Mango Lemonade | Tropical mango with a kick of chili and fresh lemon | $2.79 |
| Truffle Marcona Almonds | Roasted marcona almonds dusted with black truffle salt | $4.49 |

- **Coconut Cold Brew Concentrate** — Smooth, creamy cold brew with natural coconut flavor. $6.99
- **Mango Sticky Rice Spring Rolls** — A sweet twist on a classic, ready in minutes. $3.99

## Product Categories

A grid of category cards. On hover, each card scales up slightly and displays an overlay with the category name.

- **Snacks & Sweets** — Chips, cookies, trail mixes, and guilty pleasures
- **Fresh Produce** — Seasonal fruits, vegetables, and organic picks
- **Frozen Favorites** — Meals, appetizers, and desserts straight from the freezer
- **Beverages** — Juices, sparkling waters, coffees, and teas
- **Dairy & Cheese** — Artisan cheeses, yogurts, milk, and plant-based alternatives

- **500+ Stores Nationwide** — From coast to coast, there's a Fresh Pantry near you
- **4,000+ Unique Products** — Curated items you won't find anywhere else

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness</title>
  <meta name="description" content="A neighborhood grocery store offering unique, high-quality food products at great prices.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --green: #2D6A4F;
      --green-dark: #1B4332;
      --green-light: #40916C;
      --orange: #F4A261;
      --orange-dark: #E76F51;
      --cream: #FEFAE0;
      --cream-dark: #F5F0D0;
      --terracotta: #E07A5F;
      --yellow: #F2CC8F;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --text-dark: #264653;
      --text-mid: #4A6C6F;
      --text-light: #6B8F8F;
      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 32px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.16);
      --radius-sm: 12px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; font-family: inherit; }
    input { font-family: inherit; }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ========== HEADER ========== */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(254, 250, 224, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 32px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      transition: color var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-links a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: width var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--green); }
    .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

    .header-cta {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 10px 22px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .header-cta:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn span {
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    /* ========== HERO ========== */
    .hero {
      padding: 80px 24px 100px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -150px;
      left: -150px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
      color: var(--green);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green-dark);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .hero h1 span {
      color: var(--orange);
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      max-width: 480px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 1rem;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 1rem;
      border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.15);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-image-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .hero-img-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-img-card:nth-child(2) { margin-top: 32px; }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(3) { margin-top: -32px; }

    .hero-img-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
    }

    .hero-img-placeholder.img1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A7C957, #6A994E); }
    .hero-img-placeholder.img2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F4A261, #E76F51); }
    .hero-img-placeholder.img3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E9C46A, #F4A261); }
    .hero-img-placeholder.img4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2A9D8F, #264653); }

    .hero-float-card {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: -20px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }

    .hero-float-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.1);
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .hero-float-text strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--green-dark);
    }

    .hero-float-text span {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-light);
    }

    /* ========== FEATURED PRODUCTS ========== */
    .featured {
      padding: 80px 0;
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green-dark);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      padding: 0 24px;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .carousel-track-container {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      padding: 8px 0;
    }

    .product-card {
      min-width: 260px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .product-img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    .product-img .product-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      left: 12px;
      background: var(--orange);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .product-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .product-info h3 {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .product-info .product-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-light);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .product-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .product-price {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .product-add-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .product-add-btn:hover {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--green);
      transition: all var(--transition);

      const container = track.parentElement;
      return Math.floor(container.offsetWidth / getCardWidth());

    // Carousel
    let carouselPos = 0;
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = track.querySelector('.product-card');
      if (!card) return 280;
      return card.offsetWidth + 20;
    }

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const container = track.parentElement;
      return Math.floor(container.offsetWidth / getCardWidth());
    }

    function getMaxPos() {
      const totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card').length;
      return Math.max(0, totalCards - getVisibleCards());
    }

    function moveCarousel(dir) {
      const maxPos = getMaxPos();
      carouselPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(carouselPos + dir, maxPos));
      const offset = carouselPos * getCardWidth();
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
      updateCarouselBtns();
    }

    function updateCarouselBtns() {
      const maxPos = getMaxPos();
      document.querySelector('.carousel-btn.prev').disabled = carouselPos <= 0;
      document.querySelector('.carousel-btn.next').disabled = carouselPos >= maxPos;
    }

    updateCarouselBtns();
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      carouselPos = Math.min(carouselPos, getMaxPos());
      moveCarousel(0);
    });

    // Store Locator
    function searchStores() {
      var zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
      if (zip.length > 0) {

      if (e.key === 'Enter') searchStores();

    function subscribeNewsletter() {
      var email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
      if (email.length > 0 && email.includes('@')) {
        document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm').classList.add('visible');
        document.getElementById('emailInput').value = '';
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {

    });

            <li><a href="#">Sustainability</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-col">
          <h4>Help</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#">Store Locator</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">FAQs</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Contact Us</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Accessibility</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-col">
          <h4>Follow Us</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#">Instagram</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Facebook</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Pinterest</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">TikTok</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

        © 2024 Fresh Pantry. Discover Everyday Deliciousness.

    // Carousel
    let carouselPos = 0;
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = track.querySelector('.product-card');
      if (!card) return 280;
      return card.offsetWidth + 20;
    }

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const container = track.parentElement;
      return Math.floor(container.offsetWidth / getCardWidth());
    }

    function getMaxPos() {
      const totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card').length;
      return Math.max(0, totalCards - getVisibleCards());
    }

    function moveCarousel(dir) {
      const maxPos = getMaxPos();
      carouselPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(carouselPos + dir, maxPos));
      const offset = carouselPos * getCardWidth();
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
      updateCarouselBtns();
    }

    function updateCarouselBtns() {
      const maxPos = getMaxPos();
      document.querySelector('.carousel-btn.prev').disabled = carouselPos <= 0;
      document.querySelector('.carousel-btn.next').disabled = carouselPos >= maxPos;
    }

    updateCarouselBtns();
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      carouselPos = Math.min(carouselPos, getMaxPos());
      moveCarousel(0);
    });

      var email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
      if (email.length > 0 && email.includes('@')) {
        document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm').classList.add('visible');
        document.getElementById('emailInput').value = '';
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') subscribeNewsletter();
    });
  </script>

    .featured {

    .product-card {

      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 800;

    /* ========== CATEGORIES ========== */
    .categories {
      padding: 80px 24px;

    .categories-grid {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;

    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 3/4;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:hover {
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .category-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 4rem;
    }

    .cat-bg-1 { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #F2CC8F, #E9C46A); }
    .cat-bg-2 { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #A7C957, #6A994E); }
    .cat-bg-3 { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #90DBF4, #48CAE4); }
    .cat-bg-4 { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #F4A261, #E76F51); }
    .cat-bg-5 { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #FFE8D6, #DDBEA9); }

    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.85) 0%, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.2) 60%, transparent 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
    }

    .highlight-item {
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .highlight-item:not(:last-child)::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: -20px;
      top: 10%;
      height: 80%;
      width: 1px;
      background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.1);
    }

    .highlight-number {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = track.querySelector('.product-card');
      if (!card) return 280;
      return card.offsetWidth + 20;
    }

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const container = track.parentElement;
      return Math.floor(container.offsetWidth / getCardWidth());
    }

    function getMaxPos() {
      const totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card').length;
      return Math.max(0, totalCards - getVisibleCards());
    }

    function moveCarousel(dir) {
      const maxPos = getMaxPos();
      carouselPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(carouselPos + dir, maxPos));
      const offset = carouselPos * getCardWidth();
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
      updateCarouselBtns();
    }

    function updateCarouselBtns() {
      const maxPos = getMaxPos();
      document.querySelector('.carousel-btn.prev').disabled = carouselPos <= 0;
      document.querySelector('.carousel-btn.next').disabled = carouselPos >= maxPos;
    }

    updateCarouselBtns();
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      carouselPos = Math.min(carouselPos, getMaxPos());
      moveCarousel(0);
    });

      if (email.length > 0 && email.includes('@')) {
        document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm').classList.add('visible');
        document.getElementById('emailInput').value = '';
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') subscribeNewsletter();
    });
